summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing a press release of Q1 2026 financial results. The filing reports net earnings, book value per share, underwriting results, and discloses share repurchases of 374,883 shares for $631.3 million ($1,684 per share) and pending second-quarter transactions (sale of 23.1% of Poseidon for ~$1.9 billion and sale of Eurol). These are normal-course capital allocation and strategic updates within a quarterly earnings report, not a standalone special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is announced; the filing is a routine foreign private issuer report.
